Blood urea nitrogen and hemoglobin in COVID-19 patients: ICU and non-ICU groups

Source: R/data.R
bun_icu.Rd

Study summaries of two laboratory measures in COVID-19 patients, by group: blood urea nitrogen (BUN, in mmol/L) in bun_icu and hemoglobin (in g/L) in hgb_icu, seven studies each. Group 1 (suffix .g1) is the ICU group and group 2 (suffix .g2) the non-ICU group, as the data classify the patients. The studies come from the systematic review of Katzenschlager et al. (2021), and the two data frames are those that McGrath et al. (2023) published with their article, with the values and the column names unchanged. In bun_icu, six studies report the three quartiles of each group and one a sample mean and SD. In hgb_icu, five report the quartiles and two a sample mean and SD. They are the data of the two meta-analyses of Wu, Shi and Tong (2026), which vignette("two-meta-analyses") runs with this package.

Usage

bun_icu

hgb_icu

Format

Each a data frame with 7 rows and 13 columns, in the layout that se_imputed_diff reads with its default suffixes: author, the first author with the journal, or "Preprint", in parentheses, as the source labels the study, then for each group, with the suffix .g1 or .g2, the columns n (the sample size), q1, med, q3 (the three quartiles), mean and sd (the sample mean and SD), NA where the study does not report the value.

An object of class data.frame with 7 rows and 13 columns.

Source

The data frames dat.BUN_ICU and dat.Hgb_ICU of the repository https://github.com/stmcg/se-est, which accompanies McGrath et al. (2023), under the MIT license (copyright 2022 Sean McGrath). The license notice is in the file COPYRIGHTS of the installed package.

References

Katzenschlager S, Zimmer AJ, Gottschalk C, Grafeneder J, Schmitz S, Kraker S, Ganslmeier M, Muth A, Seitel A, Maier-Hein L, Benedetti A, Larmann J, Weigand MA, McGrath S, Denkinger CM (2021). Can we predict the severe course of COVID-19 - a systematic review and meta-analysis of indicators of clinical outcome? PLOS ONE 16(7), e0255154.

McGrath S, Katzenschlager S, Zimmer AJ, Seitel A, Steele R, Benedetti A (2023). Standard error estimation in meta-analysis of studies reporting medians. Statistical Methods in Medical Research 32(2), 373-388.

Wu Z, Shi J, Tong T (2026). Precision of the imputed mean and standard deviation from the five-number summary. Manuscript.

Examples

bun_icu
#>                     author n.g1 q1.g1 med.g1 q3.g1 mean.g1  sd.g1 n.g2 q1.g2
#> 1    Hong, Kyung Soo (YMJ)   13    NA     NA    NA    7.14 4.0698   85    NA
#> 2    Liu, Yanli (Preprint)   53  4.00   5.50  7.10      NA     NA   56  2.90
#> 3   Lei, Shaoqing (EClinM)   15  4.90   5.80 10.30      NA     NA   19  3.30
#> 4 Zhang, Guqin  (Preprint)   55  4.30   5.80  8.50      NA     NA  166  3.30
#> 5          Wang, Feng (EP)   14  7.20   9.20 11.30      NA     NA   14  3.00
#> 6       Wang, Dawei (JAMA)   36  4.30   5.90  9.60      NA     NA  102  3.10
#> 7      Cao, Min (Preprint)   19  3.53   4.54  8.23      NA     NA  171  3.54
#>   med.g2 q3.g2 mean.g2 sd.g2
#> 1     NA    NA  5.2122 3.213
#> 2   3.50  4.80      NA    NA
#> 3   4.00  4.20      NA    NA
#> 4   4.00  5.00      NA    NA
#> 5   5.00  5.50      NA    NA
#> 6   4.00  5.10      NA    NA
#> 7   4.47  5.56      NA    NA
# the difference of means, ICU minus non-ICU, with its naive and its exact
# standard error, for three studies (the vignette screens all seven by a
# skewness test and pools those that pass)
d <- se_imputed_diff(bun_icu[c(1, 5, 6), ])
d[, c("author", "scenario.g1", "yi", "sei_naive", "sei")]
#>                  author scenario.g1       yi sei_naive       sei
#> 1 Hong, Kyung Soo (YMJ)      sample 1.927800 1.1813337 1.1813337
#> 5       Wang, Feng (EP)          S2 4.795071 1.0516065 1.1144629
#> 6    Wang, Dawei (JAMA)          S2 2.582200 0.6968408 0.7453296
# the log of the SD ratio, ICU over non-ICU, with its two standard errors
h <- se_imputed_diff(hgb_icu[1:3, ], measure = "lnVR")
h[, c("author", "scenario.g1", "yi", "sei_naive", "sei")]
#>                            author scenario.g1          yi sei_naive       sei
#> 1         Huang, Chaolin (Lancet)          S2 -0.10163723 0.2467741 0.4002176
#> 2 Smadja, David M. (Angiogenesis)          S2 -0.28903251 0.2294157 0.3627600
#> 3           Hong, Kyung Soo (YMJ)      sample  0.06062462 0.2182179 0.2182179
